input.quote: d. Use of Credit Data during the term of this Agreement. Client hereby grants to TrueLink the nonexclusive worldwide right and license to use, distribute, disseminate, license, resell, exploit, upload, display, copy and store Credit Data subject to the limitations set forth in and in accordance with the Non-Competition Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 8(d) grants TrueLink a worldwide licence to distribute, disseminate, license, resell and exploit Credit Data (borrower and loan applicant data of Client and its customers) — an independent exploitation right over our data that goes far beyond processing to deliver the Hosting and Support Services, and it is not cured by the confidentiality treatment of Client Proprietary Information in Section 10(c). In addition, the Agreement contains no ownership or assignment provision for the customisation/programming work product we pay for under the Support Services (Section 10 addresses only confidentiality of "all results of the Hosting and Support Services"), no statement that Client retains rights in its data, and no bar on joint ownership; the only ownership clause, Section 2(d), runs in TrueLink's favour. That fails both the fallback and preferred positions on a material term. Our redline adds a Client work product ownership/assignment clause with a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to embedded TrueLink IP, confirms Client's retained data rights and no joint ownership, and narrows the Credit Data licence to processing solely to provide the services. TrueLink's retention of ownership of the Interface (Section 2(d)) is preserved and is acceptable.

proposal.summary: Add Client ownership of work product with assignment and licence-back, confirm Client data rights and no joint ownership, and narrow TrueLink's Credit Data licence to processing solely to provide the services.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We own the work product we fund and all of our data, so we added an ownership/assignment provision with a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to any TrueLink IP embedded in it, and confirmed there is no joint ownership. We also narrowed TrueLink's Credit Data licence, which today permits resale, distribution and exploitation of borrower data, to processing solely to provide the Hosting Services and Support Services.

ops.text: e. Client Work Product. Client owns all deliverables and work product created for Client under this Agreement, including all results of the Support Services, and TrueLink hereby assigns the same to Client. To the extent any TrueLink Intellectual Property is embedded in such deliverables or work product, TrueLink grants Client a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license to use it as part of them. Client retains all right, title and interest in Client Content, Credit Data and all other data provided by or on behalf of Client or its customers. Neither party owns any intellectual property jointly with the other.

ops.oldText: the nonexclusive worldwide right and license to use, distribute, disseminate, license, resell, exploit, upload, display, copy and store Credit Data
ops.newText: the nonexclusive worldwide right and license to use, upload, copy and store Credit Data solely to provide the Hosting Services and Support Services
